decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-595 MODIFY already captures both the primary-mint ticket-count basis and registration of randomly assigned tickets.
The existing message-595 MODIFY already requires randomly assigned no-referral tickets to be registered in ticket totals.
Correcting registration of random ticket counters does not change the unlimited-mint NFT ebook collection model.
The source establishes accounting and metadata behavior but does not request any change to user-facing FAQ content.
Excluding secondary sales from commission and ticket counts does not alter the secondary royalty amount, token standard, or enforcement policy.
Ticket and commission counter registration does not affect the NFT-detail book-access action or its visibility.
The source does not change NFT cover visibility or sizing behavior.
Excluding secondary sales from generating counted commissions and tickets does not change transfer of existing NFT entitlements, badges, or active tickets upon resale.
The source concerns commission and ticket registration, not which successfully minted NFTs are displayed as owned on the dashboard.
The mint count is used as the accounting basis, but the source does not change how successful mints themselves are counted or displayed.
The source does not change issuance of a ticket for a successful valid-referral mint; its new registration rule concerns randomly assigned no-referral tickets handled by separate Requirements.
The candidate's existing message-595 MODIFY already captures one accounted commission per primary mint, exclusion of secondary sales, and registration of randomly assigned commissions.
